name: north_america_ice_map
description: North America at the Last Glacial Maximum: same map/frame as north_america_map with the Laurentide + Cordilleran ice sheets in white (#ffffff, pale-blue #6a9cc0 outline, #d4e6f2 shading) over all of Canada incl. Hudson Bay, Alaska's southern coast range, Greenland and the Great Lakes; wavy lobed southern edge dipping to ~40N in the Midwest (Chicago under ice). Projection x=(lon+110)*12, y=-(lat-45)*12; 1440x840 frame, anchor centre.
